newsitem.title: USA: Pacalta Resources sells $120 mln 144A notes.
newsitem.headline: Pacalta Resources sells $120 mln 144A notes.

text.p: The following debt issue from Pacalta Resources Ltd was offered on Friday in the 144A private placement market via Donaldson, Lufkin and Jenrette Securities Corp, according to a syndicate source.
Pacalta Resources is headquartered in Calgary, Canada and is engaged in the acquisition, exploration, development and production of oil and natural gas, principally in Latin America.
